values: 被动地，诡草会在战场上移动攻击；主动释放时，进行一轮扫射并且使用“碎裂弹”强化后续的普通攻击。

Passive. Rhys can move while attacking.
Active. Rhys shoots at enemies and uses Blast Ammo to enhance follow-up normal attacks.

被动地，诡草会持续在场上移动攻击，若被控制则8秒内无法移动攻击。攻击速度和急速不会影响自身的动作速度，每1点攻击速度或急速使自身暴击增幅提升2点。
使用终极技能时会对扇形范围的敌人扫射，发射6发贯穿战场的子弹，每发对路径上的敌人造成280% + 40% ATK伤害，随后自身会装填“碎裂弹”，普通攻击对目标造成180% ATK伤害，对目标身后1格扇形范围的其他敌人造成40% ATK溅射伤害，直至自身被控制。

Passive. Rhys can move while attacking but is unable to do so for 8s if under control effects. ATK SPD and Haste won't affect his attack animation speed. Every 1 ATK SPD or Haste grants him 2 Crit DMG Boost.
Rhys fires at enemies within a arced radius, shooting 6 projectiles across the battlefield, each dealing 280% + 40% ATK damage to enemies on its path. Rhys then loads his lance with Blast Ammo, allowing his normal attacks to deal 180% ATK damage to the target and causing 40% ATK splash damage to enemies in a 1-tile arc behind the target until he is affected by a control effect.
扫射时，每次对路径上的敌人造成伤害提升至290% + 40% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by each projectile against enemies on its path to 290% + 40% ATK.
扫射时，每次对路径上的敌人造成伤害提升至300% + 40% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by each projectile against enemies on its path to 300% + 40% ATK.
扫射时，每次对路径上的敌人造成伤害提升至310% + 40% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by each projectile against enemies on its path to 310% + 40% ATK.
扫射时，每次对路径上的敌人造成伤害提升至320% + 40% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by each projectile against enemies on its path to 320% + 40% ATK.
诡草提升暴击，并在受到控制时免疫控制效果。
Rhys increases Crit and gains control immunity when taking control effects.
被动地，诡草提高10 + 2点暴击。诡草会在受到控制效果时释放本技能，免疫控制效果。

Passive. Rhys gains 10 + 2 Crit.
Active. Rhys gains control immunity when taking control effects.
释放本技能时，立即回复120% ATK生命值。
Restores 120% ATK HP upon casting this skill.
被动获得的暴击提升至12 + 2点。
Increases the Passive Crit bonus to 12 + 2.
被动获得的暴击提升至15 + 2点。
Increases the Passive Crit bonus to 15 + 2.
击退靠近的敌人并造成伤害。
Rhys knocks back nearby enemies and deals damage.
对距离2格以内的敌人释放，装填“震击弹”，造成220% + 25% ATK伤害，并将其击退2格。装填“碎裂弹”期间无法使用本技能。
Rhys loads Shock Ammo to shoot enemies within 2-tile, dealing 220% + 25% ATK damage and knocking them back 2-tile. He's unable to cast this skill when loaded with Blast Ammo.
提高自身暴击增幅，装填“碎裂弹”期间进一步提升暴击增幅。
Rhys' Crit DMG Boost increases during battle, and it further increases when Blast Ammo is loaded.
战斗中，自身提高22点暴击增幅。且当装填“碎裂弹”期间，额外提升8点暴击增幅。
Rhys increase his Crit DMG Boost by 22 during battle. He gains an extra 8 Crit DMG Boost when his lance is loaded with Blast Ammo.
战斗中，自身提高30点暴击增幅。且当装填“碎裂弹”期间，额外提升10点暴击增幅。
Rhys increase his Crit DMG Boost by 30 during battle. He gains an extra 10 Crit DMG Boost when his lance is loaded with Blast Ammo.
战斗中，自身提高38点暴击增幅。且当装填“碎裂弹”期间，额外提升12点暴击增幅。
Rhys increase his Crit DMG Boost by 38 during battle. He gains an extra 12 Crit DMG Boost when his lance is loaded with Blast Ammo.
持续移动一段时间后，装填“碎裂弹”强化后续的普通攻击。
Rhys loads Blast Ammo to enhance his follow-up normal attacks after moving continuously for a while.
诡草在场上移动时会逐渐提升移动速度，在5秒后达到最大速度并为自身装填“碎裂弹”。
Rhys gains bonus movement speed when moving on the battlefield. He reaches the max speed 5s into a battle and loads Blast Ammo.
“碎裂弹”对目标造成伤害提升至220% ATK，溅射伤害提升至50% ATK，溅射范围提升至目标身后2格扇形范围。
Increases Blast Ammo damage to 220% ATK and the splash damage to 50% ATK. Increases the splash range to a 2-tile arc behind the target.
“碎裂弹”对目标造成伤害提升至230% ATK，溅射伤害提升至55% ATK，溅射范围提升至目标身后2格扇形范围。
Increases Blast Ammo damage to 230% ATK and the splash damage to 55% ATK. Increases the splash range to a 2-tile arc behind the target.
“碎裂弹”对目标造成伤害提升至240% ATK，溅射伤害提升至60% ATK，溅射范围提升至目标身后2格扇形范围。
Increases Blast Ammo damage to 240% ATK and the splash damage to 60% ATK. Increases the splash range to a 2-tile arc behind the target.
The cooldown of Defensive Stance is reduced.
“坚守领域”的冷却时间降低3秒。
Reduces the cooldown of Defensive Stance to 3s.
终极技能的时间停止效果延长到所有子弹发射完毕后。若释放终极技能时自身已经装填了“碎裂弹”，则使自身额外提升120点暴击增幅和60%的移动速度，直至自身被控制。

Rhys' Ultimate now stops time until he finishes firing all bullets. If cast while Blast Ammo is loaded, he increases his Crit DMG Boost by 120 and movement speed by 60%, lasting until he's affected by a control effect.
